strings.en: So the Einst series did appear after all...
Could they be after the Star of La Mu?
It may be safe to think so.
Hm? Do you know something?
...In truth, the Star of La Mu was not made by the Mu Empire.
What...!? What do you mean, Lemuria?
I heard this from my father, La Mu... What we call the Star of La Mu
was apparently left behind by a civilization older than Mu.
So you've been using the legacy of a past civilization...?
Then it might not be from Earth at all, but left by aliens...
The Campbellians, for one, hid on Earth since long ago.
If anything, it may well be likely...
I feel that the Einst series... that sinister, mysterious enemy...
is the one most deeply connected to it...
You mean... they've come to take it back?
I have no proof, but...
According to reports, they also have some connection
to the Campbellians you mentioned, Commander.
Certainly, if we think of it that way, it may all add up...
If that's really so, then with the Star of La Mu now in our hands,
the Einst will surely come meddling with us...
We'll just have to sort out the information bit by bit...
With the Mykene Empire and the Demon Empire defeated,
the ground force's mission is all but complete.
Well... I'm glad we settled things with the Mykene, but...
That Muge guy we supposedly beat in the last war came back, right?
Shapiro, who should've died with the Dirad, was back too... Muge's doing?
Damn right... Nobody but that bastard Muge could pull that off!
That's... kind of scary...
Obsession... huh...
Indeed, I sensed an aura of tremendous malice.
And... something like an evil will, beyond mere aura...
Something evil... You mean the Einst?
No... I think it's still too early to say for certain...
It may be the powerful will of this Muge.
But this "Shadow of Muge" thing and the recent Einst
give off a similar feeling.
Really?
Yeah... I can't say for sure, but a new...
no, it's more like a hazy presence I've sensed is coming into focus.
I don't really get it...
We can't sense it. At most, we feel a sort of pressure...
What about the Gyandlar coming down to Earth?
Those unbelievable guys, yes?
Can't tell if they're robots or monsters.
Now that the chaos has settled down and our hands are freer,
those guys are probably getting antsy.
Still... even with Rom and the others working hard,
I didn't expect them to be active over such a wide area.
The enemy is getting serious, then...
What do we do from here, Captain Amuro?
The guys we were just talking about are a worry, but space is next, right?
Yeah... We have to prioritize places where we know the enemy is.
I wonder when we'll ever get to relax.
Well, not anytime soon.
Geez, how long's this gonna go on?
If we crush them one by one, it'll end eventually.
Eventually, huh...
Come to think of it, what are the Nadesico and Ra Cailum teams doing?
They report success in defeating enemy forces,
but there are still enemies whose headquarters we haven't found.
So what's left are all tougher than anything so far...
Right. We'll need to concentrate our forces and crush them for sure.
Then let's hurry up into space and meet up with Daisuke and the others.
No need to rush. Commander Hazuki is contacting the other teams now.
Hazuki / Play Mars route (Nadesico Team) / Play Moon route (Ra Cailum Team)
